subject: ggplot2 with custom stat works on cmd but not in shiny, error : "No stat called StatStepribbon"

messages.author: da366e22631d2bf1
messages.subject: ggplot2 with custom stat works on cmd but not in shiny, error : "No stat called StatStepribbon"
parts:
I created shinyApp which plots the survival data using the ggplot2. I wanted to plot the confidence interval as a filled polygon using the geom_ribbon. Unfortunately the provided geom_ribbon does not support "step-like" polygon.
For that I used the code from ggplot2 mailing list (https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!topic/ggplot2/9cFWHaH1CPs) which works fine on the command line.
However when using it in the shinyApp, it does not produce the plot and instead it gives an error : "No stat called StatStepribbon.".

The only way how to get it to work is to save the functions into a separate file and load it with:


source("functions.R", local=FALSE)

which loads it into global environment. Only then ggplot2 can find the defined stat. It does not work when functions are created in local shiny environment. The code is available here:

https://gist.github.com/ivanek/d480c0c853ea79eab82d6ef8bac9363a

I would appreciate your help.
Best
Robert
